command:
set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources"; id > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/host.txt"; uname -a >> "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/host.txt"; : > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/source-shas.txt"; for spec in 'https://github.com/banodoco/astrid-runtime.git runtime 2776ba973b6c8f3555b5629b0840d9691a98d3c2' 'https://github.com/banodoco/VibeComfy.git vibecomfy e2905d068d5851b9c32856d32b8251852a01d6dd' 'https://github.com/banodoco/runpod-lifecycle.git lifecycle 96360a27a53c4608f780f7b370f747a2aa3c7ca8' 'https://github.com/runpod/runpod-python.git runpod 0786b3d51855a66176fea1e7443b92e7ef2d01b5'; do set -- $spec; git clone -q --no-checkout "$1" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/$2"; git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/$2" fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$3"; git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/$2" checkout -q --detach "$3"; test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/$2" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$3"; printf "%s %s
" "$2" "$3" >> "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/source-shas.txt"; done; cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/venue-inputs/env-safe.sh" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/env-safe.sh"; printf "%s  %s
" dbd204d79ade2eb974d3b549f274d754aae63514261ba4be1a2823924083f3dc "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/env-safe.sh" | sha256sum -c -; chmod 700 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/env-safe.sh"; python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/r12-venv"; "$RUNNER_TEMP/r12-venv/bin/pip" install --require-hashes -r "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent/requirements/proof.lock"; export ASTRID_RUNTIME_CHECKOUT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/runtime" ASTRID_VIBECOMFY_CHECKOUT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/vibecomfy" ASTRID_RUNPOD_LIFECYCLE_CHECKOUT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/lifecycle" ASTRID_RUNPOD_CHECKOUT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/runpod" PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/runtime:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/runtime/packages/python:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/vibecomfy:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/lifecycle/src:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/sources/runpod" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP"; cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent"; set +e; "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/env-safe.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/r12-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q -o addopts= --junitxml="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/junit.xml" tests/core/generation/test_engine_release_authority.py tests/sdk/test_engine_release_handoff.py tests/core/execution/test_comfy_session_f07.py tests/core/execution/test_managed_tool_session.py tests/core/generation/test_engine_release_native_linux.py tests/core/generation/test_engine_native_fence.py > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/pytest.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; printf "%s
" "$rc" > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/inner-exit.txt"; cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/r12-proof/pytest.log"; exit "$rc"
artifact_paths:
r12-proof/host.txt
r12-proof/source-shas.txt
r12-proof/env-safe.sh
r12-proof/pytest.log
r12-proof/junit.xml
r12-proof/inner-exit.txt
